title: Why Do Lips Crack in Winter? (Even If You Drink Water)
short_title: Why Your Lips Crack in Winter (Licking Makes It Worse)
description: Why do lips crack and peel in winter even when you drink water? Here is the simple science, and the one habit that makes it worse.
comment: Do you lick your lips a lot? Be honest! 😄

scenes.text: Why do your lips crack and peel in winter, even when you drink water?
Lip skin is much thinner than the rest of your face, and it has almost no oil glands.
Without oil, there is no natural shield, so water inside your lips escapes into the dry winter air.
Then you lick them. Spit feels wet, but it evaporates fast and takes even more moisture with it.
Use a lip balm with a sealing layer, like petroleum jelly or beeswax, and keep it on.
Water helps your body, but the real fix is a shield on the outside.
